keybind.invalid: “{key}” is not a key binding. Write it like SUPER + Tab.
keybind.taken: {key} is already bound in Hyprland, so Overview did not take it. Pick another key in its settings, or free this one.

panel.hint: Click a window to go to it. Drag it onto a workspace to move it.
panel.title: Overview

keybind.description: A key that opens Overview, such as SUPER + Tab. It is added to Hyprland while Noctalia runs; a key that is already bound is left alone. Empty adds none.
keybind.label: Key binding

previews.description: Show a small picture of each window, taken with grim. Off, each window shows its app's icon and title, for systems where grim fails or is slow.
previews.label: Window previews
